__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Rane Shardbearer, Senator for Kallavesa, Seconded: Delara of the House of the Wanderer, Senator for Zenith">To commission the Hall of the Soturi, an edifice in the Kallavesa Marsh, Kallavesa. This will enable a new Wintermark army to be created with the fearless quality, a unique quality. 20 white granite, 20 weirwood, 120 crowns. Self-funded.
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs an [[edifice]] in Kallavesa Marsh, Kallavesa
* The Hall of the Soturi was first [[Flight_of_birds#No_Half_Measures|proposed]] by the Mystics of Ishal in response to a call to action from the [[Raven Seer]].
* Passed

==Date==
* Autumn 388YE

==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 20 wains of white granite
* 20 wains of weirwood
* 15 thrones in labour costs
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Hall_of_the_Soturi}}
==Outcome==
* Once complete, Wintermark will be able to raise a single new army based on the Kallavesi tradition with the fearless quality
